name: Kenan
title: Patriarch in early human history
summary: Kenan was the son of Enosh and a great-grandson of Adam. He is one of the patriarchs in the lineage from Adam to Noah, living before the flood. His name possibly means 'acquirer' or 'smith'.

keyEvents.title: The birth of Kenan
keyEvents.description: Kenan was born when his father Enosh was 90 years old, as part of the godly lineage from Seth.

keyEvents.title: The Birth of Mahalalel
keyEvents.description: When Kenan was 70 years old, he had a son named Mahalalel, who continued the lineage toward Noah.

keyEvents.title: Kenan's Long Life
keyEvents.description: Kenan lived for 910 years and had several sons and daughters during his life, typical of the patriarchs before the flood.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in Jesus' Genealogy
keyEvents.description: Kenan is included in Luke's genealogy of Jesus, showing the line back to Adam and God.
